question: Which Indian shuttler won the men’s singles final at the Scottish Open at Glasgow, Scotland on 24 November 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Lakshya Sen.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshya Sen is a Indian badminton player**.
 
• He won **gold medals in the boys' singles** competition at the 2018 **Asian Junior Championships** and the mixed team event at the **Summer Youth Olympics. **
 
• On November 24, 2019, **Lakshya Sen triumphed in the men's singles **Scottish Open final in Glasgow, Scotland. Within the last three months, he has won four titles. Lakshya Sen won the prestigious Scottish Open championship by defeating **Ygor Coelho of Brazil** in three sets (18-21, 21-18, 21-19).
 
• Originating in 1907, the **Scottish Open is one of the most famous** and enduring badminton competitions in the world. It is preceded only by the** Irish Open (1902) and the All England Open (1899).**​ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A male badminton player from** Bangalore,** India is named** Arvind Bhat**. Arvind was ranked** 87 in the world at this tim**e.
 
• **Sameer Verma **is an **Indian badminton player** who was born on October 22, 1994. He practises at** Hyderabad's Gopichand Badminton Academy**. Sourabh Verma, an Indian badminton player, has a brother named** Sameer**.
 
• According to the **BWF global rankings, **badminton player** Anand Pawar** is currently number** 44 in the world **and is one of the best players** India **has ever had.​
